unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Morroane's stiff corpse still hops in slow circles with a faded paper charm on its brow; write a fresh charm in your own blood and press it over the old one, and the body kneels and gives you its charm.
secret: You must have held your breath through an entire fight with undead, the old trick for passing unseen among them.
notice: [Breath held. The charm accepts new ink. Legendary class: Talisman-Browed Hopper.]
blurb: Follows Morroane, the Quiet Shade whose Decay-stiffened body kept moving on borrowed Blood: a mortal who bounds where others walk, like the hopping corpses of old tales.
features: Skill: Rigid Bound
Your movement becomes leaps of up to 30 feet that ignore difficult terrain, and you cannot be knocked prone or shoved.
Skill: Borrowed Blood
When you hit a creature that has blood, regain hit points equal to half the damage dealt; you resist necrotic damage.
Ultimate: Hundred-Night Procession
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you cannot drop below 1 hit point while you have drawn blood that round, and each landing leap deals 6d10 necrotic damage to creatures within 10 feet.
evolves: If you go a year without bending at the waist, your stiffened flesh grants +1 AC.
cost: Your joints no longer bend: you cannot run, swim or sit, and you must drink fresh blood once a week or lose a level of exhaustion.

unlock: On the Fogglass Spire's top floor, a trail of footprints left by Time stops mid-stride over nothing; set your feet in the last two prints and jump with your eyes closed.
secret: You must never have been late for anything in the past year, so that Time owes you nothing.
notice: [Distance skipped. Arrival confirmed. Legendary class: Gap-Stepper.]
blurb: Follows Time, who vanished leaving only footprints that end in the air: a mortal who moves a body the way Time once moved a moment.
features: Skill: Missing Stride
Once per turn as a bonus action, you teleport up to 30 feet to a space you can see.
Skill: Landing Edge
The first attack you make after teleporting has advantage and adds your proficiency bonus to its damage.
Ultimate: Mile in No Time
Once per long rest, you and up to six allies vanish and reappear anywhere you have stood within 1 mile; for the next minute your Missing Stride range doubles.
evolves: If you jump into a realm you have never visited and survive a day there, your Missing Stride can cross into it once per year.
cost: Every jump steals a moment; you age one day per teleport and always roll initiative last on the first round of a fight.

n: Steelbound Ronin of the Last Draw
requires: Level 67+; A Steel blade of your own forging
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Iron lies slain with a single curved steel blade still in its hand; defeat its lingering stance in one exchange using a blade you forged from Steel yourself.
secret: You must have refused to wield any iron weapon for a full year, since the style demands the harder metal.
notice: [One draw. One cut. The steel accepts its heir. Legendary class: Steelbound Ronin of the Last Draw.]
blurb: Follows Iron, who died honing the Katana shape from Steel rather than its own metal: a masterless swordsman whose whole art lives in the moment of drawing.
features: Skill: Sheathed Edge
While your blade is sheathed, you gain +1 AC; drawing it as part of an attack makes that attack a critical hit on 18-20.
Skill: Harder Metal
Your steel weapon ignores the AC reduction of any armour made of a lower grade metal than itself.
Ultimate: Cut Before the Draw
Once per long rest, you make one attack against every creature within 30 feet before anyone else acts, each dealing an extra 8d10 slashing damage.
evolves: If you cut through a Diamond grade object with a single draw, your blade becomes a living Steel weapon that grows with you.
cost: You may never strike with an iron weapon again; doing so shatters your blade and seals the class for a month.

unlock: Climb the First Spire to the hall where Quoleiel's empty meditation mat floats; sit on it until your breath leaves your body and returns, which is the test Quoleiel left behind.
secret: You must have fasted from food for nine days while still training, refining Martial Spirit until it no longer needs the body.
notice: [Spirit refined. The body is optional. Legendary class: Breath-Beyond-the-Body.]
blurb: Follows Quoleiel, who vanished after refining Martial Spirit so far it walked out of their body: a mortal whose inner force moves on its own.
features: Skill: Outer Breath
Your Spirit takes a shape beside you that can strike targets within 15 feet for 2d10 force damage as a bonus action.
Skill: Hands Outside
Your Spirit can grapple, parry and catch missiles on your behalf; once per turn it reduces a hit against you by 2d10.
Ultimate: The Breath That Left
Once per long rest, your Spirit grows to Huge size for 1 minute, its strikes deal 6d10 force damage and reach 60 feet, and your body is immune to all damage while it fights.
evolves: If your Spirit fights alone while your body sleeps for a full night, it becomes a second you that can act on its own.
cost: While your Spirit is outside you, your body is unconscious if it is ever more than 120 feet away.

requires: Level 23+; A shard of Quoniix's knuckle
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, a locked iron door stands over Quoniix's remains; knock on it once with your bare fist so hard it opens without being unlocked.
secret: You must have entered every room of the Spire's final floor by knocking first, never by breaking or picking a lock.
notice: [Knock acknowledged. Every door is open to you. Legendary class: Doorbreaker of the Ledger.]
blurb: Follows Quoniix, killed in Hell, whose blows turned into movement: a mortal whose strikes send bodies flying and whose knock opens any door.
features: Skill: Knocked Away
When you hit with a melee attack, you can push the target up to 20 feet; if it strikes a wall it takes an extra 2d10 bludgeoning damage.
Skill: Three Knocks
Knocking three times on any door, lock or seal opens it, magical or not.
Ultimate: Knock on the World
Once per long rest, you strike the ground: every creature within 60 feet is knocked prone and pushed 30 feet away, and every door and seal in range bursts open.
evolves: If you knock open a god's sealed door, you may knock any creature out of a realm once per year.
cost: Guards and locksmiths know your knock; you are barred from every city in a realm once your class is known there.

unlock: On the Fogglass Spire's top floor lies a still field that Gnome once walked; plant one seed and wait without speaking until the ground calms enough to show Gnome's fading trace in the furrow.
secret: You must have tilled soil with your own hands for a full season without using any Law or tool beyond a hoe.
notice: [The ground is calm. It knows you. Legendary class: Steward of the Quiet Field.]
blurb: Follows Gnome's calm side, the plain unshaped Earth with nothing stirring beneath: a mortal who makes the land itself a gentle ally.
features: Skill: Calm Footing
Ground within 30 feet of you counts as calm land: allies cannot be knocked prone and enemies treat it as difficult terrain.
Skill: Furrow and Field
Once per short rest, you raise a field of grass and soil in a 30 foot radius that grants allies inside half cover.
Ultimate: Land That Listens
Once per long rest, for 1 minute the land in a 120 foot radius obeys you: you can open trenches, raise mounds and swallow Large or smaller creatures with a Strength save.
evolves: If you stop an earthquake or eruption with calm alone, you can draw on Gnome's deeper earth.
cost: You lose all power on stone floors, worked roads and anywhere the land is not calm.

unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Ishvaune left a trace in the form of a queue of a thousand ghosts; wait to be the very last one through the gate without ever pushing ahead.
secret: You must honestly have been last at something that mattered to you, and accepted it without complaint.
notice: [You were last. That is enough. Legendary class: Final Claimant.]
blurb: Follows Ishvaune, who vanished after claiming Last, the harder half of First: a mortal who wins by being the one who remains at the end.
features: Skill: Last to Act
You may delay your turn to the end of the round; when you do, your attacks that turn deal an extra 3d10 damage.
Skill: Last Word
You always get a final action: when you would drop to 0 hit points, you can take one action first.
Ultimate: Last One Standing
Once per long rest, if you are the last ally still standing in a fight, you regain all hit points and every attack you make for 1 minute is a critical hit.
evolves: If you outlast a holder of First in a contest, you can claim both halves of the paired Law.
cost: You always roll initiative last and can never be the first to do anything in a contest.

n: Molten Heir of the Fused Vein
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Ignis's last trial is a floor of fire and earth fighting for room; fuse a handful of each in your bare hands until they become one molten stone.
secret: You must have stood in an active volcano's mouth and walked out without using fire resistance.
notice: [Fire and earth are one. The flow continues. Legendary class: Molten Heir of the Fused Vein.]
blurb: Follows Ignis, slain when part of its Fire fused with Gnome's Earth to make Lava: a mortal whose body runs with molten rock.
features: Skill: Molten Ground
Ground you walk on becomes molten for 1 round, dealing 2d10 fire damage to enemies that enter it.
Skill: Cooling Crust
When hit, you can harden your skin into crust, reducing that hit's damage by 2d10 once per turn.
Ultimate: The Mountain Opens
Once per long rest, you erupt: a 40 foot radius floods with lava for 1 minute, dealing 8d10 fire damage to creatures that start their turn there.
evolves: If you build a new mountain from your own lava, Gnome and Ignis's children both answer you once.
cost: Water hurts you; being submerged deals 2d10 damage per round and hardens you, halving your speed.

unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Ryzeiel's remains sit under a brass plaque with their name scratched out; restore the name from memory of every deed they did, gathered floor by floor.
secret: You must have finished a task a dead person left undone, without ever claiming the credit.
notice: [A name restored. Its weight is now yours. Legendary class: Bearer of the Unpaid Name.]
blurb: Follows Ryzeiel, killed in Hell and remembered only by reputation: a mortal who wields what the dead leave behind instead of power.
features: Skill: Reputation Precedes
Creatures that know your name have disadvantage on their first attack against you, and you gain advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation.
Skill: Inherited Deeds
Once per long rest, you call on a dead ally's legacy to use one feature, spell or skill they had in life.
Ultimate: Name Remembered
Once per long rest, every creature within 120 feet who has heard your legend is charmed or frightened (your choice) for 1 minute.
evolves: If ten thousand people know your story, your legacy outlives you as a lingering Spirit that guards your heirs.
cost: Every disgraceful act is remembered; a single betrayal turns your reputation and reverses Reputation Precedes against you.

requires: Level 78+; Passing Vatheur's self-writing book test
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Vatheur vanished leaving a book that writes itself; tell it a true deed of yours until the retelling grows larger than what happened, and the book closes on your name.
secret: You must have heard a story about yourself that was more impressive than the truth, and never corrected it.
notice: [The tale has outgrown the teller. Legendary class: Teller of the Grown Tale.]
blurb: Follows Vatheur, who vanished into their own Chronicles: a mortal whose deeds grow bigger each time they are retold.
features: Skill: Retold Larger
Once per short rest, after rolling, you can treat any one d20 as 20, as if the story already said so.
Skill: Heard Around the Fire
Allies who have heard your legend gain your proficiency bonus to saving throws while within 60 feet of you.
Ultimate: The Tale Comes True
Once per long rest, you narrate one feat aloud; for 1 minute you can attempt it as if you had any needed ability, and you succeed if a d20 roll beats 10.
evolves: If a bard in another realm sings your legend, the class can be felt and borrowed across realms.
cost: The truth fades as the legend grows; you slowly forget what really happened and must make Wisdom saves to tell your own memories from stories.

unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Quodoeth's phylactery spins between floors; catch it and pour a piece of your own Spirit into it while you are still alive.
secret: You must have raised yourself from death once by your own hand, not by another's spell.
notice: [Your Spirit has a second home. Legendary class: Undying Self-Keeper.]
blurb: Follows Quodoeth, killed after carrying their own body and Spirit into undeath: a mortal who keeps all their power past death.
features: Skill: Kept Spirit
You resist necrotic and cold damage and do not need to eat, drink or breathe.
Skill: Undead Clarity
Spells you cast deal an extra 2d10 necrotic damage, and you can see invisible creatures within 30 feet.
Ultimate: Return From the Vessel
Once per long rest, when you die your Spirit flees to your phylactery and you reform there at full hit points after 1 minute.
evolves: If your phylactery survives a whole realm's destruction, you can raise yourself without it ever again.
cost: If your phylactery is broken, you lose this class and die at the next sunrise.

unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Ortaix's body lies beside a mirror that shows only truths; tell it a lie it believes, and take Ortaix's tongue from beneath its pillow.
secret: You must have told a lie that saved someone's life without them ever knowing it.
notice: [A lie accepted as true. Legendary class: Silver-Tongued Forsworn.]
blurb: Follows Ortaix, killed for wielding Lies more easily than anyone wielded Truth: a mortal whose falsehoods bend belief.
features: Skill: Believed Lie
Once per short rest, a creature that hears your lie must make a Wisdom save or believe it completely for 1 hour.
Skill: Two Faces
You gain advantage on Deception checks and on saves against effects that detect lies.
Ultimate: The Great Falsehood
Once per long rest, you speak a lie that everyone within 60 feet believes for 1 minute, even if it changes what they see and hear.
evolves: If you deceive a god into breaking their own contract, your lies can bend small Laws.
cost: No one can trust you; anyone who learns your class treats every word you speak as a lie.

requires: Level 1+; A drop of Life's cooling blood
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Life lies dead beside a cup still warm with its blood; drink it before the blood stops moving.
secret: You must have pulled a dying ally back from the brink with your own blood, not with a spell.
notice: [Life stolen. Life kept. Legendary class: Thief of the Last Heartbeat.]
blurb: Follows Life, killed with its Blood still flowing: a mortal who pulls another's Blood-bound Life into their own body.
features: Skill: Stolen Beat
When you deal damage with a melee attack, regain hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.
Skill: Before It Stops
When a creature within 30 feet drops to 0 hit points, gain temporary hit points equal to its Hit Dice.
Ultimate: The Last Heartbeat
Once per long rest, you drain a creature within 30 feet: it makes a Constitution save or takes 6d10 necrotic damage and you regain twice that much.
evolves: If you steal the Life from something that cannot die, you stop aging.
cost: Healing spells cast on you work at half strength; only stolen Life heals you fully.

unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Iron vanished leaving a single straight line scratched across the floor; walk along it in the mist without stepping off once.
secret: You must have hit a target farther than any archer or spear-thrower you know could.
notice: [Reach over spread. Legendary class: Long-Reach Lancer.]
blurb: Follows Iron's trace in the Line shape, favouring reach over spread: a mortal whose every strike travels straight and far.
features: Skill: Straight Reach
Your melee attacks reach 15 feet, and spells that affect an area can be cast as a 60 foot line instead.
Skill: Unbroken Line
Creatures in a line between you and your target take half the attack's damage.
Ultimate: Line Across the World
Once per long rest, you strike a 300 foot line, dealing 8d10 force damage to every creature in it and splitting any object.
evolves: If your line pierces a Tower floor, your reach can cross a realm once a year.
cost: You cannot fight in close quarters; enemies within 5 feet have advantage against you.

unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Ornoane's body is chained to a door it locked from the inside; open it without breaking the lock, then lock it again behind you.
secret: You must have kept a secret locked away for years without ever writing it down.
notice: [Shut. Not held down. Legendary class: Warden of the Shut Hold.]
blurb: Follows Ornoane, killed holding a door shut forever: a mortal who binds things closed instead of pinning them down.
features: Skill: Shut Fast
As a reaction, you lock a door, chest, mouth or spell within 30 feet; it stays shut until you open it or it is broken.
Skill: Locked Body
You gain +1 AC and cannot be moved against your will while you are holding a doorway.
Ultimate: Lock the Hold
Once per long rest, you seal a 60 foot area: nothing can enter or leave it for 1 minute, including spells and teleportation.
evolves: If you lock away a god's power, you can seal a realm's gate once per year.
cost: You must lock everything you own; a lock left open drains your power for a day.

requires: Level 89+; A segment of Vanoor's stretched spine
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Vanoor's corpse lies stretched across the whole floor; walk its length from head to foot, which takes a full day.
secret: You must have carried something too long to be carried, such as a ship's mast, up a mountain alone.
notice: [Size extended. Legendary class: Stretchwright of the Endless Hand.]
blurb: Follows Vanoor, killed while making things longer: a mortal who lengthens shapes, limbs and weapons.
features: Skill: Lengthen
Your weapons and spells reach twice as far, and your limbs can extend up to 30 feet.
Skill: Longer Moment
Effects you create last twice as long.
Ultimate: The Endless Reach
Once per long rest, your arms stretch up to 1 mile for 1 minute, letting you strike or grasp anything you can see.
evolves: If you lengthen a day into two, you can make time longer once per year.
cost: Your stretched body is fragile; you take an extra 1d10 damage from every hit.

unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Haniane left a trace as a silk curtain that shows what you want most; walk through it without reaching for what you see.
secret: You must have wanted something with your whole heart and given it up for nothing.
notice: [Desire refined. Legendary class: Heir of the Velvet Want.]
blurb: Follows Haniane, who vanished into pure Desire: a mortal whose wanting becomes a force others cannot resist.
features: Skill: Velvet Pull
Creatures within 30 feet must make a Wisdom save or be drawn 10 feet toward you each turn.
Skill: Want Unmasked
You know what every creature within 60 feet wants most, and gain advantage on checks to bargain with it.
Ultimate: The Original Want
Once per long rest, every creature within 120 feet is charmed by you for 1 minute and fights for you.
evolves: If you make a god want something, you can bend their contract.
cost: You want everything; you must take one thing you desire each day or have disadvantage on all checks.

unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Gravity vanished leaving a trace of iron filings that drift toward one empty spot; stand in it and choose, aloud, the single thing you wish to pull, and only that thing comes.
secret: You must have found a lost object by feel alone, with no light and no Law to guide you.
notice: [The pull is selective. It chose you back. Legendary class: Lodestone Chooser.]
blurb: Follows Gravity's gentler, choosier pull: a mortal who draws only the things they name, metal first and everything else later.
features: Skill: Chosen Pull
As a bonus action, you pull one metal object or armoured creature within 60 feet up to 30 feet toward you.
Skill: Repelling Field
Metal weapons that attack you subtract an extra 1 from their damage per grade below yours (+1 AC against metal only).
Ultimate: Lodestar
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every metal object within 120 feet obeys you: you can disarm, crush armour for 4d10 damage, or hurl blades as a storm dealing 8d10 damage.
evolves: If you pull a falling star from the sky, the class evolves to choose things beyond metal.
cost: Compasses spin near you, and you cannot carry iron without it slowly drifting away.

requires: Level 12+; A cracked cog from Iron's remains
unlock: On the Fogglass Spire's top floor, Iron's last trial is a hall of machines built without Redundancy; break every one with a single well-placed fault before they finish their cycle.
secret: You must have watched a machine you built fail and kept its broken pieces rather than discarding them.
notice: [Fault located. Fault exploited. Legendary class: Breaker of Careless Works.]
blurb: Follows Iron, slain by its own unchecked designs: a mortal who finds the one weak part in anything made and makes it fail.
features: Skill: Find the Fault
As a bonus action, you see the weak point of a construct, object or armour; your next hit against it ignores its AC.
Skill: Cascading Failure
When you destroy a construct or object, every connected mechanism within 30 feet stops working for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Total Breakdown
Once per long rest, every construct, trap and Man-Made item within 60 feet (except yours) must make a save or stop working for 1 minute.
evolves: If you break a god's artifact, you can force any Law to misfire once per year.
cost: Your own gear breaks too; on a natural 1, the item you are using malfunctions until repaired.

unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Ulmiael died at an anvil; finish the half-made item still on it with nothing natural, using only crafted tools and bought fuel.
secret: You must have built something that worked better than anything nature grows for the same task.
notice: [Crafted, not grown. Legendary class: Forge-Proud Maker.]
blurb: Follows Ulmiael, killed proving that mortal craft could rival a dying spirit's power: a mortal whose crafted things carry Law.
features: Skill: Crafted Grade
Items you craft count as one realm grade higher than their materials.
Skill: Workshop Anywhere
You can craft any item in one hour instead of days, using only tools and parts you carry.
Ultimate: Masterwork
Once per long rest, you craft one item in 1 minute that grants its wielder +2 to attack and damage and one effect of your choice for 1 day.
evolves: If you craft an item a god envies, the class evolves into a Law of your own making.
cost: You cannot use Natural Laws such as Druid magic, and wild creatures distrust you.

unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Quoroar vanished leaving a single feather that changes colour when touched; change it a hundred small ways without once transforming it into anything else.
secret: You must have fixed a ruined thing by changing only one small detail of it.
notice: [Small change accepted. Legendary class: Fine-Hand Shifter.]
blurb: Follows Quoroar, who vanished after forcing small changes on the world without full Transformation: a mortal who tweaks reality piece by piece.
features: Skill: Small Shift
As an action, you change one property of an object within 30 feet: colour, weight, hardness or temperature.
Skill: Shifted Flesh
Once per short rest, you shift a creature's body: it makes a Constitution save or has disadvantage on attacks for 1 minute.
Ultimate: A Hundred Small Changes
Once per long rest, you make up to ten small changes in a 60 foot area at once, such as turning walls to glass or water to ice.
evolves: If you change one detail of a god's Law, you can manipulate Laws themselves.
cost: Nothing you shift stays shifted; all changes revert after a day.

unlock: On the Fogglass Spire's top floor, Zetheiel left a trace as a rack of masks; find the one that is yours by wearing each until none of the reflections recognise you.
secret: You must have lived a whole month under another name without anyone noticing.
notice: [Identity hidden. Legendary class: Faceless Guest.]
blurb: Follows Zetheiel, who vanished behind a mask, hiding identity rather than truth: a mortal who can be anyone.
features: Skill: Borrowed Face
You can take the appearance and voice of any creature you have seen, as a bonus action.
Skill: Unknown Name
You cannot be identified by divination or scrying, and anyone who looks for your true name fails.
Ultimate: Every Face in the Room
Once per long rest, every creature within 60 feet sees you as the person they trust most for 1 minute.
evolves: If you take a god's face and fool their own priests, your mask becomes permanent and flawless.
cost: You forget your own face; you must keep one portrait or lose your identity entirely.

unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Iron left a trace: a vast silent clock still ticking with no one to wind it. Find the one missing gear by ear alone, cut it from your own gear, and set it in place.
secret: You must have built a working machine of at least a hundred moving parts and never let anyone else touch it.
notice: [Missing gear supplied. The mechanism resumes. Legendary class: Mainspring Pilgrim.]
blurb: Follows Iron, who vanished into its own moving parts rather than any single fixed shape: a mortal who builds gearwork and slowly becomes part of it.
features: Skill: Wound Tight
Once per short rest, you wind yourself as a bonus action: for 1 minute you gain an extra action each turn, usable only to Attack, Dash or use an object.
Skill: Gearwork Squire
You build a Medium mechanical companion with hit points equal to your level and +1 AC; it acts on your turn and can carry, shield or strike for 2d10 damage.
Ultimate: The Great Escapement
Once per long rest, you unfold into a Huge walking engine for 1 minute, gaining 100 temporary hit points and a slam that deals 6d10 bludgeoning damage in a 15 foot radius.
evolves: If your companion runs for a full year without you winding it, it gains a Spirit and the class evolves.
cost: You must wind your own mainspring each dawn; miss a day and your speed is halved until you do.

requires: Level 89+; A thread from Sylph's mended body
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Sylph's body lies torn into ribbons of wind; mend each tear with needle and thread, never a spell, before you forget the floor below.
secret: You must have mended a stranger's broken thing without being asked and without accepting payment.
notice: [Torn things knit. Legendary class: Needle-Kind Restorer.]
blurb: Follows Sylph, killed and torn apart, whose gentlest Law was Mend, closer to Heal than to any smith's repair: a mortal who sews the world closed.
features: Skill: Stitch the Wound
As an action, touch a creature to restore 4d10 hit points and close any bleeding, or fully repair one object.
Skill: Seam of Peace
Creatures you have mended this day cannot willingly attack you, and allies within 30 feet regain 1d10 hit points at the start of their turns.
Ultimate: Mend the Tear
Once per long rest, you mend everything within 60 feet: allies regain 10d10 hit points, objects are whole again, and a rift or broken ward closes.
evolves: If you mend something a god broke on purpose, you can stitch Laws back together.
cost: You can never harm anything you have mended, and unmended damage you see causes you pain.

unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Kaniiel left a trace as a puzzle that only turns while no one moves; sit before it for a full day, perfectly still, until it solves itself in your head.
secret: You must have won a fight without anyone being touched, by thought alone.
notice: [Body set aside. Mind admitted. Legendary class: Quiet-Seated Sage.]
blurb: Follows Kaniiel, who vanished into the Mental trait that Wisdom and Intelligence share: a mortal whose mind becomes their hands, shield and blade.
features: Skill: Clear Mind
You add your Intelligence modifier to Wisdom saves and your Wisdom modifier to Intelligence saves, and you cannot be charmed.
Skill: Thought Over Muscle
You can use Intelligence instead of Strength or Dexterity for attacks, checks and saves.
Ultimate: The Weight of Thought
Once per long rest, every creature within 60 feet makes an Intelligence save or is stunned for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn.
evolves: If you out-think a god in a contest of wits, your mind can rewrite a minor Law once.
cost: Your body withers; you have disadvantage on Constitution saves and cannot wear heavy armour.

requires: Level 89+; A cloudy shard of Harais's mind
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Harais's corpse lies in a room where fear, sadness and confusion drift like weather; walk through each storm and name aloud what it does to you before it can.
secret: You must have pulled yourself out of a long despair without anyone's help.
notice: [State observed. State named. Legendary class: Weatherwatcher of Minds.]
blurb: Follows Harais, killed by what splinters of Fear, Confusion and Sadness left in minds: a mortal who reads mental states like weather and changes them.
features: Skill: Read the Sky
You always know the current mental state and conditions of every creature within 60 feet.
Skill: Shift the Weather
As an action, impose or remove frightened, confused or despairing on one creature within 30 feet (Wisdom save to resist).
Ultimate: Storm Front
Once per long rest, a mental storm fills 60 feet for 1 minute: enemies choose a random target for each attack, and allies are immune to fear and charm.
evolves: If you calm a god's madness, you can set a mind's weather permanently.
cost: You feel every state you see; when a creature near you is frightened, so are you.

n: Sparing Blade of the Long War
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Ulron left a trace as a battle of shades that never ends; end it without striking a single killing blow, while the shades keep trying to kill you.
secret: You must have spared an enemy who later saved your life.
notice: [Mercy shown in war. Legendary class: Sparing Blade of the Long War.]
blurb: Follows Ulron, who vanished in the middle of a War rather than win it by killing: a mortal whose spared foes lay down their arms.
features: Skill: Spare
When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, it falls unconscious instead of dying and has disadvantage on attacks against you from then on.
Skill: Merciful Ward
While you have not killed anything today, you and allies within 10 feet gain +1 AC.
Ultimate: Lay Down Arms
Once per long rest, every hostile creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or drops its weapons and cannot attack for 1 minute.
evolves: If you spare an enemy army, the class evolves to spare whole battles at once.
cost: If you ever kill a creature that has surrendered, the class is sealed until you atone.

unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Life vanished leaving a banquet that refills itself; eat for seven days without sleep until your body learns to burn food into strength in a breath.
secret: You must have eaten something deadly and burned the poison out with your body alone.
notice: [Intake converted. Legendary class: Hearth-Bellied Glutton.]
blurb: Follows Life's Metabolism, the speed a body turns Health into Muscle or Ki: a mortal who eats and immediately becomes stronger.
features: Skill: Burn the Meal
As a bonus action, eat a ration to gain temporary hit points equal to your level.
Skill: Fast Body
You shake off poison, disease and one level of exhaustion at the end of each of your turns.
Ultimate: The Inner Furnace
Once per long rest, you burn your reserves for 1 minute: double speed, an extra 4d10 damage on hits, and you regain 2d10 hit points each turn.
evolves: If you live off your own stored fat for a full year, you never need to eat again.
cost: You must eat five full meals a day or take a level of exhaustion.

unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Gnome's corpse still holds metal no one has ever shaped; reach into its stone heart barehanded and draw out raw ore without forging it.
secret: You must have refused to forge, bend or sell any metal for a full year.
notice: [Raw metal answers. Legendary class: Ore-Blooded Primarch.]
blurb: Follows Gnome, slain at the very root of Iron, Steel and Diamond: a mortal whose blood runs with metal before it has a name.
features: Skill: Ore Skin
You gain +2 AC and resistance to slashing and piercing damage.
Skill: Before the Shape
As an action, you reshape any metal within 60 feet into a new form, including weapons in enemy hands.
Ultimate: Mother Lode
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every metal within 1 mile obeys you, rising as walls, spears or chains as you choose.
evolves: If you shape a metal grade that does not yet exist, the class evolves to name it.
cost: You sink in water and lightning damage against you is doubled.

unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Iron left a trace as a watch the size of a grain of sand; open and repair it without magnification or Law.
secret: You must have built something small enough to sit on your fingernail.
notice: [Scale reduced. Legendary class: Tinker of Grain-Sized Works.]
blurb: Follows Iron's Micro law, mechanics too small for Precision alone: a mortal who fights with machines no one can see.
features: Skill: Grain Traps
You carry ten tiny traps; as a bonus action, scatter one within 30 feet that deals 1d10 damage and halves speed when triggered.
Skill: Under the Lock
You can open any mechanical lock or disable any trap as a bonus action.
Ultimate: Dust of Gears
Once per long rest, you release a cloud of tiny machines in a 30 foot radius that deals 6d10 damage to enemies inside each turn for 1 minute.
evolves: If you build a machine too small for anyone to see, the class evolves toward Nano.
cost: You need steady hands; any amount of alcohol or fear makes your devices fail.

unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Aelshayr vanished leaving a flock that circles the floor forever; break its loop and lead every bird down the stairs without losing one.
secret: You must have led a group across a whole realm without losing a single member.
notice: [The flock follows. Legendary class: Leader of the Long Flight.]
blurb: Follows Aelshayr, who vanished leading a migration, moving a whole group rather than a single Animal: a mortal whose people travel as one body.
features: Skill: As One
You and up to ten allies move at your speed and cannot be separated by teleport or terrain.
Skill: Season's Call
Once per long rest, a migrating herd or flock arrives to fight or carry you for 1 hour.
Ultimate: The Great Turning
Once per long rest, you move up to 100 willing creatures across a realm in a single day.
evolves: If you lead a migration through the Void, the class can carry groups between realms.
cost: You must move with the seasons; spending a full season in one place seals your power.

unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Divine vanished leaving a chalice that pours more than it holds; drink, then pour out more than you took to heal a dying stranger in the hall.
secret: You must have healed someone beyond what your god contract should allow.
notice: [Miracle confirmed. Legendary class: Overflowing Vessel.]
blurb: Follows Divine, who vanished leaving miracles behind when Heal works better than diluted power should: a mortal whose grace exceeds its limits.
features: Skill: Overflow
Your healing spells and features restore an extra 4d10 hit points.
Skill: Unasked Grace
Once per long rest, cast any healing spell without using a slot.
Ultimate: The Miracle
Once per long rest, you restore a creature that died within the past day to life with full hit points.
evolves: If you perform a miracle before a god, they offer you a contract at no price.
cost: The holy church learns of you; you are hunted or worshipped, never ignored.

requires: Level 12+; A gust from Sylph's still-moving remains
unlock: On the Fogglass Spire's top floor, Sylph's last trial is a room that shifts around you; sway and stumble with it until you can cross it without a single step looking planned.
secret: You must have travelled somewhere new every day for a year.
notice: [Motion confirmed. Legendary class: Ever-Swaying Wanderer.]
blurb: Follows Sylph, killed in plain motion, the Law Flight, Turn and Speed all specialise: a mortal who sways like a drunkard and is never where the blow lands.
features: Skill: Unplanned Step
Your speed doubles and you cannot be grappled or restrained.
Skill: Lurching Dodge
As a reaction, move 10 feet when attacked; the attack misses if you leave its reach.
Ultimate: Everything Moves
Once per long rest, you move every creature and object within 60 feet to any space within 60 feet of it.
evolves: If you move a mountain, the class evolves into the motion of the land itself.
cost: You cannot stand still; if you do not move on your turn, you take 2d10 damage.

unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Gnome vanished leaving a swamp of rain-soaked earth that never dries; wade through it to its centre and drink a handful without drying any of it.
secret: You must have lived in a marsh for a year and never once used fire to dry yourself.
notice: [Neither earth nor water. Legendary class: Mire-Born Heir.]
blurb: Follows Gnome's ground that never dried after Undine's rain: a mortal of both Earth and Water, neither fully.
features: Skill: Mire Footing
Ground within 30 feet becomes mud: difficult terrain for enemies, normal ground for you.
Skill: Clay Skin
You resist bludgeoning damage and gain +1 AC while standing in mud.
Ultimate: Swallowing Fen
Once per long rest, a 120 foot area becomes deep mire: enemies are restrained and sink 5 feet each turn.
evolves: If you reconcile the children of Gnome and Undine, the class evolves to command both.
cost: You must stay wet; a day dry gives you a level of exhaustion.

unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Selnoor's remains lie copied a hundred times; find the real body by counting what all the copies share.
secret: You must have doubled your fortune in a single trade without cheating.
notice: [Increase confirmed. Legendary class: Many-Fold Heir.]
blurb: Follows Selnoor, killed by a Void law of increase: a mortal who multiplies effects instead of adding to them.
features: Skill: Twofold
Once per short rest, double one damage roll or healing roll.
Skill: Many Hands
You create a copy of yourself with 1 hit point that lasts 1 minute and acts on your turn.
Ultimate: Infinite Fold
Once per long rest, you create ten copies of yourself for 1 minute.
evolves: If you hold a hundred copies at once for a full minute, Many Hands copies become permanent companions.
cost: Each copy that dies costs you 1d10 hit points, and your gold halves every time you multiply it.

n: Wrapped Keeper of the Long Tomb
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Life vanished leaving a sealed tomb; wrap yourself in its linen and lie there a full day while its floor rearranges around you.
secret: You must have preserved a body against Decay with rites, not Law.
notice: [Preserved. Legendary class: Wrapped Keeper of the Long Tomb.]
blurb: Follows Life's preservation against Decay: a mortal who trades speed for kept power.
features: Skill: Wrapped Body
You resist necrotic and poison damage and are immune to rot and disease; you gain +1 AC while fully wrapped.
Skill: Preserving Rite
Over a short rest, you wrap a corpse in linen; it stays perfect forever and can later be raised with half its original power, slow but loyal.
Ultimate: The Long Tomb
Once per long rest, up to five wrapped corpses rise for 1 hour with all their original power, and enemies they touch are cursed so that magical healing fails on them.
evolves: If you wrap a fallen god and keep it whole for a century, the class evolves into the keeper of that god.
cost: You are slow; your speed is halved and you can never take the Dash action.

unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Iron vanished leaving a flask of clear water that is secretly full of tiny workers; brew it into a cure for the sick climber on the floor without ever seeing what you are mixing.
secret: You must have finished an Alchemy recipe so fine that a master could not tell what was in it.
notice: [Too small to see. Not too small to command. Legendary class: Alchemist of the Unseen Grain.]
blurb: Follows Iron's Nano law, the extreme cousin of Micro wielded in careful Alchemy: a mortal whose brews are armies too small to see.
features: Skill: Living Tincture
Your potions and alchemical items carry tiny workers: they heal or harm an extra 2d10 and last twice as long.
Skill: Inside Work
As an action, a creature you touch makes a Constitution save or your workers sabotage it from within: 4d10 damage and disadvantage on attacks for 1 minute.
Ultimate: The Grey Tide
Once per long rest, you release an unseen cloud in a 60 foot radius for 1 minute that unmakes nonmagical objects and deals 6d10 damage to enemies each turn.
evolves: If your workers rebuild a destroyed thing on their own, they become self-replicating and the class evolves.
cost: Your workers sometimes stray; on a natural 1 your Nano effect also targets you.

unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Morroune vanished leaving a wild grove that grows without any god's hand; live in it for a month without shaping, pruning or planting anything.
secret: You must have let a garden you owned go wild for a whole year and loved it more for it.
notice: [Left alone. Thriving. Legendary class: Untended Grove-Speaker.]
blurb: Follows Morroune, who vanished into Nature, the four elements acting together when left alone: a mortal who lets the world do as it will, and it answers.
features: Skill: Four Together
Once per short rest, call fire, water, earth and wind together: a 30 foot burst dealing 4d10 damage of each element's type to enemies.
Skill: Unshaped Ground
Wild terrain within 60 feet favours you: allies gain +1 AC and enemies have disadvantage on Stealth.
Ultimate: Wild Season
Once per long rest, for 1 minute a 1 mile area returns to untouched wilderness: buildings crumble into forest and every plant and beast fights for you.
evolves: If you return a whole city to the wild, the class evolves into a guardian of all four elements.
cost: You cannot cast spells or use Laws inside cities, forges or any place built by mortal hands.

n: Pale Lantern of the Grave Chance
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Morsayr vanished leaving a graveyard of a hundred corpses; raise one without any Pact, knowing the chance of failure grows with every attempt.
secret: You must have been scorned by a town for raising the dead, and raised one anyway to save that town.
notice: [The dead rise. Not every time. Legendary class: Pale Lantern of the Grave Chance.]
blurb: Follows Morsayr, the scorned Pale Keeper who raised corpses without Pacts on chance alone: a mortal who works the dead for no one's approval.
features: Skill: Pactless Raising
Once per short rest, you touch a corpse and roll a d20: on 10 or higher it rises as your servant with half its power until destroyed.
Skill: Grave Odds
Your necrotic spells deal an extra 2d10 damage, and you add your proficiency bonus to raising rolls.
Ultimate: Lantern Over the Field
Once per long rest, every corpse within 120 feet rises at once, no roll required, and fights for you for 1 hour.
evolves: If a whole town thanks you for raising its dead, the class evolves and the scorn turns to awe.
cost: Living creatures distrust you; you have disadvantage on Persuasion checks with any non-undead creature.

unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Ortaiel vanished leaving a hall where every Law is cast at you at once; stand in the centre and cancel each, not resist it, until the hall goes quiet.
secret: You must have refused a god's contract to their face.
notice: [Law denied. Legendary class: Voice That Says No.]
blurb: Follows Ortaiel, who vanished after cancelling Laws outright rather than resisting them: a mortal whose word unmakes spells.
features: Skill: Flat Refusal
As a reaction, cancel a spell or Law effect of a level up to your proficiency bonus targeting a creature within 60 feet.
Skill: Null Space
You and creatures within 10 feet cannot be targeted by magic you do not allow.
Ultimate: The Great No
Once per long rest, all magic and Law effects in a 120 foot radius end and cannot be used for 1 minute, except yours.
evolves: If you cancel a god's Law, you can deny one Law permanently.
cost: Your own healing and helpful spells from others fail on you half the time.

unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Rynior left a trace: a scarecrow that never bleeds. Make it bleed by giving it a thousand shallow cuts, without one deep wound.
secret: You must have won a duel lasting at least an hour without ever landing a serious blow.
notice: [A thousand small cuts. Legendary class: Thousand-Cut Duellist.]
blurb: Follows Rynior, who vanished after mastering the small cut that never closes: a mortal whose every nick becomes a slow Bleed.
features: Skill: Never Closing
Every hit you land leaves a Bleed: the target takes 1d10 damage at the start of its turns, stacking up to ten times.
Skill: Shallow Dance
You can make one extra attack each turn that deals only 1 damage but adds a Bleed stack.
Ultimate: Death of a Thousand Cuts
Once per long rest, every Bleed stack on a creature deals its damage at once, then resets.
evolves: If you bring down a creature of twice your level with nicks alone, Never Closing can stack up to twenty times.
cost: Your blows are weak; your weapon damage dice are halved.

unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Drasael vanished leaving a bed where every sleeper dreams of Hell; sleep in it, face the worst dream, and lead it out of your head on a leash.
secret: You must have slept through a whole week of nightmares without waking anyone.
notice: [A dream led out. Legendary class: Bad-Dream Shepherd.]
blurb: Follows Drasael, who vanished into Dreams turned foul by Hell and Void: a mortal who leads nightmares like sheep.
features: Skill: Herd of Dreams
Creatures you damage cannot benefit from a long rest until you allow it.
Skill: Stray Nightmare
As an action, send a nightmare into a creature within 60 feet: 4d10 psychic damage and frightened for 1 minute (Wisdom save).
Ultimate: The Waking Nightmare
Once per long rest, a shared nightmare fills 120 feet for 1 minute: enemies are frightened and take 4d10 psychic damage each turn.
evolves: If you shepherd a god's nightmare, it becomes your pet and companion.
cost: You never sleep peacefully; your long rests give only half hit points.

unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Life vanished leaving a corpse that wakes only at dusk; walk with it through one night and get it back to its grave before dawn.
secret: You must have travelled only by night for a month.
notice: [After dark, the dead walk. Legendary class: Sundown Rider.]
blurb: Follows Life's Nightwalker trace, drawing on any corpse but only holding together after dark: a mortal who is strongest between dusk and dawn.
features: Skill: Night-Held
At night, you gain +1 AC, darkvision 120 feet, and an extra 2d10 necrotic damage on hits.
Skill: Borrowed Body
At night, you can raise any corpse within 30 feet as a servant until dawn.
Ultimate: Night Without End
Once per long rest, you make it night within 1 mile for 1 hour.
evolves: If you see a sunrise without falling, the class evolves to endure daylight.
cost: At dawn, you and your servants collapse into an inert state until dusk.

requires: Level 12+; A leaf from Notus's last autumn
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Sylph's body lies, and the quiet wind Notus still waits beside it; keep vigil beside them through one long autumn night without speaking.
secret: You must have stayed beside a dying friend until the end.
notice: [The quiet wind follows. Legendary class: Damp-Wind Mourner.]
blurb: Follows Notus, the quiet autumn wind that followed Boreas's winter rage and stayed by Sylph's corpse: a mortal who brings the damp wind of change.
features: Skill: Damp Gust
As an action, a 30 foot cone of damp wind pushes enemies 15 feet and douses flames.
Skill: Autumn's Turn
Once per long rest, change the season in a 1 mile area to autumn for 1 day.
Ultimate: Season of Mourning
Once per long rest, a storm of damp wind fills 120 feet for 1 minute: enemies are slowed and take 4d10 cold damage each turn.
evolves: If you calm Boreas's rage, the class evolves to control all seasons.
cost: You cannot bear to leave the dead; you must bury every corpse you find.

unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Kazeis's corpse rests one hand on a white-hot brand it never felt; take the brand and hold it while the choir sings, until the singing is the only thing you can feel.
secret: You must have finished a fight on a broken limb without once crying out.
notice: [Touch refined the wrong way. Pain declined. Legendary class: Dead-Nerve Brawler.]
blurb: Follows Kazeis, killed by Touch refined in the wrong direction: a mortal who feels nothing and spreads that nothing through every blow.
features: Skill: Felt Nothing
You cannot be frightened or stunned, and once per turn you reduce the damage of one hit by 1d10.
Skill: Deadening Blow
When you hit with an unarmed strike or melee weapon, the target's next attack roll has disadvantage and it cannot take reactions until its turn.
Ultimate: The Long Numb
Once per long rest, every creature within 60 feet makes a Constitution save or is paralyzed for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn.
evolves: If you feel something again after a year of numbness, the class evolves and you learn to give feeling back as healing.
cost: You notice no wounds; the DM tracks your hit points and you learn them only when you rest.

n: Heart That Will Not Let Go
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Varoar's corpse still clutches a locket it loved too hard; pry it loose finger by finger while the corpse weeps and begs you to stop.
secret: You must have kept loving someone or something for years after it was gone.
notice: [A love that will not end. Legendary class: Heart That Will Not Let Go.]
blurb: Follows Varoar, killed by a splinter of Love that never let go and turned toward Dark: a mortal whose fixation becomes strength.
features: Skill: Fixed Gaze
Choose one creature as your fixation; you have advantage on all rolls against it and always know where it is in the same realm.
Skill: Will Not Let Go
Your fixation cannot move away from you willingly while within 30 feet, and you cannot be moved away from it.
Ultimate: Only You
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you and your fixation are cut off from everyone else: no one can enter, leave, target or help either of you.
evolves: If your fixation chooses you in return, the class evolves into something closer to the Love it came from.
cost: You may change your fixation only when it dies; until then all other creatures have advantage against you.

requires: Level 23+; An Obsidian shard of Ignis
unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Ignis's last trial is a river of lava that must be cooled in one breath; plunge your blade in and pull it out as black glass before the hymn ends.
secret: You must have killed a target with a single cut they did not feel until afterwards.
notice: [Cooled too fast. Left sharp. Legendary class: Glass-Edge Assassin.]
blurb: Follows Ignis, slain in Heaven, whose Lava cooled too quickly to be ground again and stayed sharp: a mortal whose edges are black glass.
features: Skill: Volcanic Edge
Your weapons become obsidian: they deal an extra 2d10 slashing damage and score critical hits on 19-20.
Skill: Shattering Edge
When you crit, the blade splinters inside the wound, dealing 2d10 damage at the start of the target's next two turns.
Ultimate: Glass Rain
Once per long rest, a storm of obsidian shards fills a 60 foot radius, dealing 8d10 slashing damage to every enemy and leaving them bleeding.
evolves: If you cut through a Diamond-grade ward in a single stroke, your edges stop splintering on you and Shattering Edge triggers on every hit.
cost: Your blades are brittle; on a natural 1 your weapon shatters and must be re-cooled from fresh lava.

unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Thaldoth's body lies beside a jar of salve that changes recipe every hour; heal a wounded climber with it without ever repeating the same mixture.
secret: You must have healed someone with nothing but an ointment you made yourself.
notice: [Balm accepted. Legendary class: Balm-Hand Apothecary.]
blurb: Follows Thaldoth, killed among their own Alchemy jars, master of the salve that Rub applies: a mortal whose hands carry healing ointments.
features: Skill: Rubbed Balm
As a bonus action, rub balm on a creature you touch: it regains 3d10 hit points and ends one poison or disease.
Skill: Lasting Salve
Creatures you have treated gain resistance to one damage type of your choice for 1 hour.
Ultimate: Great Unction
Once per long rest, you anoint all allies within 30 feet: they regain all hit points and are immune to conditions for 1 minute.
evolves: If you treat a hundred different wounds without ever repeating a recipe, your balm can be thrown 30 feet as a healing splash.
cost: You must gather fresh herbs each dawn; stale balm heals nothing and stings for 1d10 damage.

unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Orzeiel's corpse is ancient beyond counting; sit beside it and trade away your remaining years until there is nothing left to trade, then stand.
secret: You must have grown old without regret.
notice: [Nothing left to trade. Legendary class: Grey-Crowned Elder.]
blurb: Follows Orzeiel, killed by Old, what Age becomes when there is nothing left to trade: a mortal whose age becomes power.
features: Skill: Old Wisdom
You add twice your proficiency bonus to Wisdom and Intelligence checks.
Skill: Weight of Years
When you hit, the target ages a decade and has disadvantage on Strength rolls for 1 minute.
Ultimate: The Grey Crown
Once per long rest, all enemies within 60 feet age a century for 1 minute, gaining exhaustion and disadvantage on everything.
evolves: If you reach a hundred years of age with this class, Weight of Years can take a decade from a foe and give it to an ally as youth.
cost: You are frail; your speed is halved, your Strength drops by 2, and you never grow younger by any means.

unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Gnome vanished leaving a trace of living soil that crawls; grow a plant in it without any metal tool.
secret: You must have never used a metal tool for a year.
notice: [Living matter, not metal. Legendary class: Living-Matter Gardener.]
blurb: Follows Gnome's living matter, set apart from Metal and Man-Made things: a mortal who grows weapons and armour instead of forging them.
features: Skill: Grown Gear
Your weapons and armour are grown from wood and bone and heal themselves over a short rest.
Skill: Living Bond
Plants and creatures within 30 feet heal 1d10 at the start of your turn.
Ultimate: Living Garden
Once per long rest, a 60 foot area becomes a living garden that heals allies and entangles enemies for 1 minute.
evolves: If a tree you grew from seed outlives the oldest building in your home town, Grown Gear can be grafted onto allies.
cost: Worked metal sickens you; wearing or wielding any metal item gives disadvantage on Constitution saves.

unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Ostzeel's corpse holds a book of where every Law came from; read the first page aloud without forgetting a word.
secret: You must have traced your family line back ten generations.
notice: [Origin known. Legendary class: Root-Seeker of First Things.]
blurb: Follows Ostzeel, killed by Origin, the Void's word for where every Law first came from: a mortal who knows where things begin.
features: Skill: Know the Source
As an action, you learn the Origin of any spell, Law or creature within 60 feet.
Skill: Back to Origin
Once per short rest, you send a summoned creature or spell back to its source.
Ultimate: The First Page
Once per long rest, all summoned creatures and spells within 120 feet return to their origin.
evolves: If you learn the true Origin of whatever killed Ostzeel, you may name a new Origin for one Law, changing what it opposes.
cost: Every origin you learn sticks; after each long rest make a Wisdom save or lose a recent memory to make room.

unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Selsaael vanished leaving a run that only ends when you collapse; sprint the full plain without stopping and keep going after your body says no.
secret: You must have fought until you passed out.
notice: [Fatigue deferred. Legendary class: Redline Berserker.]
blurb: Follows Selsaael, who vanished into Overdrive, a boost that borrows against fatigue not yet felt: a mortal who pushes past every limit.
features: Skill: Redline
As a bonus action, you overdrive for 1 minute: an extra attack each turn and +2d10 damage.
Skill: Borrowed Strength
While in overdrive, you cannot drop below 1 hit point.
Ultimate: Past the Red
Once per long rest, your overdrive triples: three extra attacks and +6d10 damage for 1 minute.
evolves: If you stay standing through a whole battle in Redline and after it ends, the debt is forgiven and the exhaustion falls to one level.
cost: When Redline or Past the Red ends, the borrowed fatigue arrives at once as three levels of exhaustion.

unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Rydoix's corpse still holds the last contract it signed with a Devil; read every clause, find the loophole that killed Rydoix, and sign beneath it with that loophole closed.
secret: You must have struck a deal with a Devil and paid it back early, in full.
notice: [Clause amended. Debt recognised. Legendary class: Countersigner of Debts.]
blurb: Follows Rydoix, killed by the small print of a Devil's bargain: a mortal who lends power now and always collects later.
features: Skill: Lend and Collect
As a bonus action, grant an ally within 30 feet an extra 2d10 damage on their next hit; at the start of their next turn they owe you 1d10 hit points, which you gain.
Skill: Binding Clause
When a creature breaks a promise made to you, it takes 6d10 psychic damage and you learn its location for a day.
Ultimate: Foreclosure
Once per long rest, every creature that owes you anything within 120 feet must pay at once: you take one feature, spell slot or item from each for 1 hour.
evolves: If a Devil signs a contract with you as the lender, Devils within the realm treat you as a creditor.
cost: You must keep every bargain to the letter; breaking one ends the class and sends your soul's deed to Hell.

unlock: At the top of the Sunken Spire, Morriur's body lies both alive and dead; walk to it by descending upward, then carry its paradox home without settling which it is.
secret: You must have believed two contradicting things for a year without trying to resolve them.
notice: [Contradiction held. Do not resolve. Legendary class: Unresolved Riddle-Bearer.]
blurb: Follows Morriur, killed by a Void law built from a contradiction that refuses to resolve: a mortal who holds two answers at once.
features: Skill: Both and Neither
Once per short rest, when a creature makes an attack or save against you, it is both a success and a failure: you choose the better part of each.
Skill: Riddle in the Mind
As an action, you speak a paradox to a creature within 60 feet; it makes an Intelligence save or is incapacitated trying to resolve it for 1 minute.
Ultimate: The Unresolvable
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you exist in two places at once: you take two full turns each round and attacks have only half a chance to hit either of you.
evolves: If you hold a paradox long enough to become one, you can cancel any effect by contradicting it.
cost: You lose a little of yourself each time; after each Ultimate make a Wisdom save or forget which of your two memories is real.

unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Vesdoune vanished leaving a trace inside a living host who wanders the floor; coax the trace out and take it into yourself without killing the host.
secret: You must have lived off another's labour for a year without giving anything back.
notice: [Host selected. Nothing is given in return. Legendary class: Tick-Bound Leech.]
blurb: Follows Vesdoune, who vanished into Parasitism, the one-sided form of Symbiosis: a mortal who latches onto others and takes.
features: Skill: Latch
As a bonus action, latch onto a creature within 5 feet; while latched you take half damage and it takes 1d10 at the start of your turns, which you regain.
Skill: Borrowed Defences
While latched, you share the host's AC and resistances if they are better than yours.
Ultimate: Burrow Deep
Once per long rest, you burrow into the host for 1 minute; you control its movement and it attacks its own allies.
evolves: If you latch onto a god for a full day without being thrown off, you take one of their Laws.
cost: You need a host; for each day you spend unlatched, take a level of exhaustion.

unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Time vanished leaving a corridor of moments already gone; walk back through it to the first memory you have and stay there for an hour without changing a thing.
secret: You must have forgiven something from your past that no one else did.
notice: [What happened stays happened. Legendary class: Reader of Settled Hours.]
blurb: Follows Time's face that mortals reach for most, the Past: a mortal who reads, revisits and borrows from what already was.
features: Skill: Read the Past
By touching an object or place, you see everything that happened to it in the past day.
Skill: Borrowed Yesterday
Once per short rest, you replace a d20 roll with the one you rolled for that same type of roll last time.
Ultimate: Settled Hour
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you replay a past moment: everything within 60 feet returns to how it was a minute ago, except you.
evolves: If you meet your past self in Time's corridor and change nothing, Settled Hour can rewind a full hour instead of a minute.
cost: You live partly in the past; you have disadvantage on initiative rolls.

unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Morraas vanished leaving a tiny animal that sings with the choir; befriend it without offering food or command.
secret: You must have kept a small animal as a companion for a year.
notice: [A small friend bound. Legendary class: Little-Friend Keeper.]
blurb: Follows Morraas, who vanished into Pet, a gentler Tame that binds small things: a mortal whose small companion grows into something mighty.
features: Skill: Little Friend
You bond with a Tiny companion with hit points equal to your level, which can grow to Large as a bonus action.
Skill: Fierce Small Friend
Your companion's attacks deal 3d10 damage and it shares your AC.
Ultimate: Small No More
Once per long rest, your companion becomes Gargantuan for 1 minute, gains 100 temporary hit points and its attacks strike every enemy within 15 feet.
evolves: If your companion saves your life on its own initiative, it unlocks a hidden class of its own.
cost: If your companion dies, you lose this class until you bond another.

unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Divine vanished leaving a hospital where the church's spells all fail; heal every patient there using the old physic of herbs, splints and bleeding.
secret: You must have healed someone with old remedies after the church refused them.
notice: [The old way works. Legendary class: Old-Way Bonesetter.]
blurb: Follows Divine's older, clumsier word for Heal, used by those who distrust the holy church: a mortal who heals without faith.
features: Skill: Set the Bone
As an action, you restore 4d10 hit points to a creature by physic; this works even where magic does not.
Skill: Old Remedy
Once per short rest, cure any disease, poison or curse without magic.
Ultimate: The Long Practice
Once per long rest, all allies within 60 feet regain all hit points and lose one level of exhaustion.
evolves: If you heal a wound that a holy miracle could not, Set the Bone can also regrow a lost limb.
cost: The holy church disowns you; divine healing works at half strength on you.

unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Vaniis's body lies under a boulder no Law can lift; lift it with muscle alone, while your reflection tries to convince you to use magic instead.
secret: You must never have cast a spell or used a Law in your life.
notice: [Body only. No Spirit, no Mind. Legendary class: Flesh-First Champion.]
blurb: Follows Vaniis, killed holding the broad Physical category that Martial, Muscle and Strength fall under: a mortal who trusts only the body.
features: Skill: Pure Muscle
Add your Strength modifier to AC (max +2) and to Constitution saves; you are immune to effects that lower Strength.
Skill: Unaided
Your unarmed strikes and weapon attacks deal an extra 1d10 damage for each spell or Law effect active on your target.
Ultimate: The Body Answers
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your Strength becomes 30 and you can lift, hurl or break anything up to Gargantuan size.
evolves: If you defeat a spellcaster of twice your level without any magical help, you resist all spell damage.
cost: You can never cast spells, use magic items, or accept magical healing.

unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Gnome vanished leaving a vein of Diamond in a floating rock; mine it out with a pickaxe without breaking a single crystal.
secret: You must have mined Iron or Diamond with your own hands rather than buying it.
notice: [The ground opens. Legendary class: Deep-Vein Delver.]
blurb: Follows Gnome, who vanished leaving the Pickaxe shape, built for ground rather than fights: a mortal who digs, and fights like they dig.
features: Skill: Strike the Seam
Your pickaxe ignores the AC of stone or metal armour and deals double damage to constructs and objects.
Skill: Tunnel Through
You gain a burrow speed equal to your walking speed through stone and earth.
Ultimate: Cave-In
Once per long rest, you collapse the ground in a 60 foot radius: enemies fall 30 feet and are buried, restrained until they dig out.
evolves: If you mine a grade of ore no one has found before, your pickaxe becomes a living Gnome-grade tool.
cost: You crave the dark; in sunlight you have disadvantage on attack rolls.

unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Ulkaael vanished leaving a sickbed; lie in it, catch the plague it carries, and walk out alive and carrying it.
secret: You must have survived a plague that killed everyone else in your town.
notice: [Plague carried. The end walks with you. Legendary class: Grey Rider's Herald.]
blurb: Follows Ulkaael, who vanished into Plague, one of the four Laws that walk together at the world's end: a mortal who carries sickness.
features: Skill: Carried Sickness
Creatures that start their turn within 10 feet of you make a Constitution save or are poisoned and take 2d10 poison damage.
Skill: Rot of the Many
Your poison and necrotic damage ignores resistance.
Ultimate: Pestilence
Once per long rest, a plague spreads through a 1 mile area for 1 hour: enemies take 4d10 poison damage each minute and cannot heal.
evolves: If you ride beside Famine, War and Apocalypse, you become one of the four.
cost: You cannot touch anyone without infecting them; your allies must stay away.

unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Cosmic's corpse lies across two layers of reality at once; step into the second layer and walk out of the first.
secret: You must have visited three different realms in one year.
notice: [Layers crossed. Legendary class: Layer-Stepper.]
blurb: Follows Cosmic, killed holding Plane, a whole layer of reality built from Dimension: a mortal who walks between layers.
features: Skill: Step Aside
As a bonus action, you step into another layer of reality: you cannot be targeted until the start of your next turn.
Skill: Layered Strike
Your attacks deal an extra 2d10 force damage and ignore cover.
Ultimate: Fold the Planes
Once per long rest, you shift everything within 60 feet onto a layer of reality you choose for 1 minute, where enemies have disadvantage and allies resist all damage.
evolves: If you open a gate to a realm you have never seen, you can travel between realms freely.
cost: Each step aside leaves you a little less real; after the third in a day, you have disadvantage on Charisma checks and mirrors stop showing you.

unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Vesvayr's remains orbit a central light; catch each wandering body as it passes and set them in order.
secret: You must have charted the movement of the wandering stars for a full year.
notice: [The wanderers align. Legendary class: Wanderer-Star Augur.]
blurb: Follows Vesvayr, killed holding the wandering Cosmic bodies as one Law: a mortal who reads and calls on them.
features: Skill: Read the Wanderers
At dawn, roll three d20s; you can use them to replace any rolls before your next long rest.
Skill: Orbiting Guard
Three small planets orbit you, each reducing damage from one hit by 2d10 before breaking.
Ultimate: Alignment
Once per long rest, every planet aligns: you call down a 60 foot pillar dealing 10d10 force damage.
evolves: If you predict a god's fall and it comes true, Read the Wanderers gives five dice instead of three.
cost: Your fate is written in the stars; you cannot change a prediction once made.

requires: Level 67+; A sliver of Cosmic's velocity
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Cosmic's remains still race too fast to see; catch one sliver of them in your hand without slowing it down.
secret: You must have moved so fast once that you outran sound.
notice: [Velocity uncontained. Legendary class: Lightspeed Wreck.]
blurb: Follows Cosmic, killed when a sliver of it became pure velocity: a mortal who moves faster than gods can reckon.
features: Skill: Pure Velocity
Your speed triples and you can move through enemies.
Skill: Searing Streak
Creatures you pass through take 3d10 radiant damage.
Ultimate: Lightspeed
Once per long rest, you become a streak of light for 1 round: you take three turns in a row, and every creature you pass through takes 6d10 radiant damage.
evolves: If you outrun a falling star and catch it, you can carry one ally at Pure Velocity.
cost: Your body burns from speed; each turn you move more than double speed, take 1d10 damage.

requires: Level 1+; Passing Life's quickrot vineyard test
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Life vanished leaving a vineyard whose grapes rot in minutes; brew a single drop of venom from them before the whole crop is gone.
secret: You must have been poisoned by your own brew and drunk it again the next day to learn it.
notice: [Decay hastened. Years become minutes. Legendary class: Quickrot Vintner.]
blurb: Follows Life's darker trace, Poison, a weaponised sliver of Decay sped up: a mortal whose brews rot a lifetime in a breath.
features: Skill: Hastened Venom
Coat a weapon as a bonus action; your next three hits deal an extra 1d10 poison damage and the target is poisoned for 1 minute.
Skill: Vintner's Tongue
You are immune to poison and can taste any toxin in food or drink before it harms you.
Ultimate: Decade in a Drop
Once per long rest, a creature you hit makes a Constitution save or ages ten years and takes 6d10 necrotic damage as its body rots forward.
evolves: If you brew a poison that kills an undying thing, Hastened Venom can rot stone and metal too.
cost: Plants wilt where you sleep, and no garden or orchard will bear fruit within a mile of your home.

requires: Level 56+; A grain of Vesleel's last pollen
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Vesleel's corpse lies among flowers that never bloom; carry pollen between all of them by hand until the whole floor flowers at once.
secret: You must have tended a beehive for a full year without being stung.
notice: [Life carried between flowers. Legendary class: Bloom-Courier.]
blurb: Follows Vesleel, killed carrying Life between Flowers: a mortal who moves Life from place to place in pollen and petals.
features: Skill: Carried Life
As a bonus action, transfer up to 2d10 hit points from one willing creature within 30 feet to another.
Skill: Petal Cloud
Once per short rest, release pollen in a 20 foot radius: allies inside regain 3d10 hit points and enemies are blinded until they leave.
Ultimate: Full Bloom
Once per long rest, all plants within 1 mile bloom at once: allies regain all hit points and enemies are charmed by the scent for 1 minute.
evolves: If you bring a dead forest back into flower, Carried Life can carry life into the newly dead.
cost: Bees and insects swarm you everywhere; you have disadvantage on Stealth checks outdoors.

unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Quotheune's remains rest on a pedestal marked with every skill not yet tried; touch it, and you must fail at a hundred things you have never tried before it lets you go.
secret: You must never have trained in anything for the purpose of being good at it, only for joy.
notice: [Aptitude untested. Ceiling unknown. Legendary class: Untested Prodigy.]
blurb: Follows Quotheune, killed holding Potential, what Aptitude looks like before it is tested: a mortal who can become anything, once.
features: Skill: First Try
You have advantage the first time you ever attempt any skill, tool, spell or weapon.
Skill: Untapped
Once per long rest, gain proficiency in any one skill, tool or weapon until your next long rest.
Ultimate: What You Could Have Been
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you gain all the features of any one other class at your level.
evolves: If you master something you failed at during the trial, you can keep one feature from your Ultimate permanently.
cost: Every second attempt at something is harder; you have disadvantage the second time you try anything.

unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Iron's corpse holds a mechanism with a gap thinner than a hair; fit a part into it before you forget the floor below.
secret: You must have built something that would fail if it were off by a hair.
notice: [Precision confirmed. Legendary class: Hair's-Breadth Engineer.]
blurb: Follows Iron, killed holding Precision, the difference between a working Blacksmith design and a ruined one: a mortal who never misses by even a hair.
features: Skill: Exact Hit
Any d20 you roll for an attack or tool check counts as at least 8, and items you build never malfunction.
Skill: Hair's Breadth
Once per short rest, you can turn a miss into a hit.
Ultimate: The Perfect Strike
Once per long rest, your next attack automatically hits and is a critical hit dealing maximum damage.
evolves: If you build a mechanism that runs a full year without a single fault, Hair's Breadth can be used twice per short rest.
cost: Any flaw you notice nags at you; until you fix it you have disadvantage on Wisdom checks.

unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Time's corpse is caught in a single instant; step into that instant and act within it before it passes.
secret: You must have lived a whole day without thinking of past or future.
notice: [The present is held. Legendary class: Now-Bound Ascetic.]
blurb: Follows Time, killed in the thinnest sliver, the Present: a mortal who lives fully in the now.
features: Skill: Now
You cannot be surprised and add your Wisdom modifier to initiative.
Skill: Instant Strike
Once per turn, when you hit, you make one more attack against the same target in the same instant.
Ultimate: The Eternal Now
Once per long rest, the present stretches: you take two extra full turns at once, and no one can react to anything you do in them.
evolves: If you hold a single instant for a full minute of your own time, the Eternal Now can include one ally.
cost: You cannot plan ahead: you can never take the Ready action, and you forget plans made more than a day ago.

unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Zemias's body lies beneath a fallen banner; raise it and hold it high on the open plain until every lost knight rallies.
secret: You must have refused to retreat from a battle you knew you would lose.
notice: [Pride shared. Legendary class: Banner-Proud Knight.]
blurb: Follows Zemias, killed holding Pride, close kin to Ego but shared: a mortal whose pride lifts everyone around them.
features: Skill: Shared Pride
Allies within 30 feet gain your Charisma modifier to attack rolls.
Skill: Unbowed
You cannot be frightened, and allies within 30 feet have advantage against fear.
Ultimate: Banner Raised
Once per long rest, all allies within 120 feet regain all hit points and have advantage on everything for 1 minute.
evolves: If a hundred soldiers rally to your banner in one battle, Shared Pride reaches anyone who can see the banner.
cost: You cannot retreat, surrender or refuse a challenge made in public.

unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Iron's corpse lies pinned by the last thing it threw, a single spoken word turned to iron; pull it free and throw it back through the target at the far wall.
secret: You must have knocked a foe down by throwing something that was never meant to be thrown, such as a boot, a loaf or an insult.
notice: [Anything can fly. Legendary class: Hurler of Anything.]
blurb: Follows Iron, killed holding the shape-neutral Projectile law that lets a Dart, a Ball or even a word be thrown with force: a mortal who turns whatever is in hand into a missile.
features: Skill: Everything Flies
Any object you can lift is a thrown weapon for you with range 60/180 feet, dealing 1d10 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier.
Skill: Thrown Word
As a bonus action, hurl a shouted word at a creature within 60 feet: 2d10 force damage and it is knocked prone (Strength save).
Ultimate: Volley of the Armoury
Once per long rest, every loose object within 30 feet of you flies at once, dealing 8d10 damage split as you choose among creatures within 120 feet.
evolves: If you throw a boulder the size of a house, Everything Flies works on creatures you grapple.
cost: Your hands are never empty for long; you cannot hold onto keepsakes, as you throw anything in reach when startled.

unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Life vanished leaving a heartbeat that echoes from no body; follow it across the forgetting floor and match your own heart to it before you lose track of why.
secret: You must have kept someone alive by pressing on their chest until help came.
notice: [Rhythm matched. Life holds. Legendary class: Drum-Hearted Watcher.]
blurb: Follows Life's Pulse, the rhythm Blood keeps while Life still holds it and the first thing Heal checks for: a mortal who hears and steers every heartbeat.
features: Skill: Hear the Beat
You sense every living creature within 120 feet by its heartbeat, through walls and invisibility, and know its hit points.
Skill: Steady the Rhythm
As a reaction when an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points, they instead drop to 1 and regain 2d10 hit points.
Ultimate: Skip a Beat
Once per long rest, every enemy within 60 feet makes a Constitution save or its heart stops for 1 round: stunned and taking 6d10 damage.
evolves: If you restart a heart that has been still for a full day, Steady the Rhythm can bring back the newly dead.
cost: Your own pulse is loud; you have disadvantage on Stealth against anything that can hear.

unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Kamios's corpse wears a different lineage on every limb; name each one and the land it was born in before you forget the floor below.
