secret: You must have lived among a lineage other than your own for a year and been accepted as kin.
notice: [Lineage read. Legendary class: Blood-Line Weaver.]
blurb: Follows Kamios, killed holding Race, the category for Elves, Beastmen and every lineage a mortal can be born into: a mortal who borrows traits from any bloodline.
features: Skill: Borrowed Heritage
After a long rest, choose any lineage you have met; you gain its traits in place of your own until your next long rest.
Skill: Kin to All
Creatures of any lineage treat you as one of their own; you have advantage on Charisma checks with them.
Ultimate: All Bloods at Once
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you gain the traits of up to three lineages at once.
evolves: If you are adopted into a lineage that has never accepted outsiders, its traits become permanently yours.
cost: You forget your own lineage; your birth family no longer recognises you.

unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Eirkael vanished leaving a mirror that shows you everyone who ever wronged you; smash it, then stop yourself before you smash the next one.
secret: You must have let anger carry you through a fight you should have lost, and won.
notice: [Instinct overridden. Anger takes the reins. Legendary class: Red-Mist Unbound.]
blurb: Follows Eirkael, who vanished into Rage, what Anger becomes when a Martial cultivator lets it override Instinct: a mortal whose fury is a weapon.
features: Skill: Red Mist
As a bonus action, enter the red mist for 1 minute: resistance to physical damage and an extra 2d10 damage on melee hits.
Skill: Feed the Fire
While in the red mist, every time you take damage your next hit deals an extra 1d10.
Ultimate: Blind Fury
Once per long rest, your red mist becomes total for 1 minute: you cannot drop below 1 hit point and attack every creature within reach each turn, friend or foe.
evolves: If you calm your own rage mid-fight to spare an ally, you can choose your targets during Blind Fury.
cost: In the red mist you cannot tell friend from foe; at the end of each turn make a Wisdom save or attack the nearest creature.

unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Ostzeune vanished leaving a locked cage with something you love inside; bargain for it with the mist itself without breaking the cage.
secret: You must have negotiated someone's freedom without paying a single coin.
notice: [Something held. Something owed. Legendary class: Hostage-Broker.]
blurb: Follows Ostzeune, who vanished into Ransom, a narrower Take that holds rather than keeps: a mortal who takes things hostage and trades them back.
features: Skill: Held for Trade
When you hit, you can take one item, spell slot or feature from the target and hold it until they pay your price.
Skill: Ransom Note
A creature whose item you hold has disadvantage on attacks against you.
Ultimate: Everything Has a Price
Once per long rest, you hold one thing from every enemy within 60 feet for 1 minute.
evolves: If you ransom a god's Rune back to them, you gain a contract from them free of price.
cost: You must always return what you hold if the price is paid, even to enemies.

unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Liokaix's remains are the only solid thing in the floor; touch them and hold reality together around you while the floor falls apart.
secret: You must have refused to believe an illusion even when everyone else did.
notice: [Reality held. Legendary class: Weaver of What Is.]
blurb: Follows Liokaix, killed holding Reality, the Void's word for what all other laws act on: a mortal who bends the foundation itself, at great risk.
features: Skill: What Is
You see through all illusions and invisibility, and you can dispel one illusion as a bonus action.
Skill: Small Edit
Once per short rest, change one small fact about the world within 30 feet: a door was always locked, a rope was always there.
Ultimate: Rewrite
Once per long rest, change one larger fact within 120 feet for 1 minute, such as the ground being water or an enemy being an ally.
evolves: If you hold reality together in the Void for a full day, Small Edit becomes permanent.
cost: Every edit risks the rest; on a natural 1, a random fact around you changes too.

unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Ishnoiel vanished leaving a throne with a crown on it; refuse to sit on it, and lead the floor's shades to topple it instead.
secret: You must have broken an unjust law in public and stood your ground when the guards came.
notice: [Governance refused. Legendary class: Torch of the Unruled.]
blurb: Follows Ishnoiel, who vanished into Rebellion, the paired opposite of Governance and the commoner of the two: a mortal who throws off every rule.
features: Skill: No Masters
You are immune to charm and to any effect that commands you, and you have advantage on saves against Laws used by rulers or gods.
Skill: Rally the Many
As a bonus action, allies within 30 feet who are fighting someone of higher rank gain an extra 1d10 damage on hits.
Ultimate: The Throne Falls
Once per long rest, every creature within 120 feet that is commanded, charmed or bound is freed, and for 1 minute your allies have advantage against any ruler, noble or god.
evolves: If a whole town rises behind you, No Masters extends to every ally within 30 feet.
cost: You cannot swear fealty to anyone; accepting a god contract or a lord's oath seals the class.

unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Nyshan's corpse sits in a ring of rings, each one a blow it sent back; stand in the centre and send every blow the floor throws at you back to where it came from.
secret: You must have won a fight in which you never struck first.
notice: [Force returned. Legendary class: Recoil Fighter.]
blurb: Follows Nyshan, killed holding Rebound, a Void law that sends force back the way it came: a mortal who fights with what the enemy gives them.
features: Skill: Send It Back
As a reaction when hit by a melee attack, reduce the damage by 2d10 and deal that much to the attacker.
Skill: Recoil Step
After you are hit, you can move 15 feet without provoking.
Ultimate: The Great Rebound
Once per long rest, for 1 minute all damage you take is also dealt to its source.
evolves: If you rebound a god's blow, Send It Back works against spells and Laws too.
cost: You cannot strike first; your first attack each fight has disadvantage unless you were hit first.

unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Ostsaar vanished leaving a spellbook with blank pages; cast one spell into it and draw it back again without spending anything.
secret: You must have run out of magic in a fight and kept casting anyway by sheer will.
notice: [Spent magic redrawn. Legendary class: Second-Draw Scribe.]
blurb: Follows Ostsaar, who vanished into Recast, a minor Void law that draws a spent spell again: a mortal whose magic is never fully used up.
features: Skill: Second Draw
Once per short rest, after you cast a spell, you can cast it again on your next turn without spending a slot.
Skill: Echoed Words
When you recast a spell, it gains an extra 2d10 damage or healing.
Ultimate: The Endless Page
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every spell you cast is cast twice.
evolves: If you recast a spell that a god cast, Second Draw can copy any spell you have seen.
cost: Your spells grow faint; spells cast for the third time in a day deal half damage.

unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Ultaos's corpse clutches a recipe whose steps rearrange every hour; finish the dish while the floor shuffles, using only what Ultaos wrote.
secret: You must have recreated a lost recipe from a single burnt page.
notice: [Recipe followed. Legendary class: Keeper of the Last Instruction.]
blurb: Follows Ultaos, killed holding Recipe, the written form of Alchemy useless without someone who understands the Law: a mortal whose written steps carry power.
features: Skill: Written Steps
You can write a recipe for any potion you have seen; anyone following it creates that potion.
Skill: Double Batch
Potions and alchemy items you create come in pairs.
Ultimate: The Master Recipe
Once per long rest, you write a recipe that, when followed, grants any one spell effect up to 5th level.
evolves: If you write a recipe that outlives you, your recipes can be followed even by those who do not understand them.
cost: You must follow every recipe to the letter; deviations always fail.

unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Iron's corpse lies inside two identical machines; disable one without stopping the other.
secret: You must have built a second backup for something that never failed.
notice: [Built twice. Legendary class: Twice-Built Bulwark.]
blurb: Follows Iron, killed holding Redundancy, the Mechanical law of building twice so one fault does not cost the whole design: a mortal with a backup for everything.
features: Skill: Spare Part
When you would drop to 0 hit points, drop to half your maximum instead, once per long rest.
Skill: Double Guard
Your armour and shield count as two layers: +1 AC and each hit is reduced by 1d10.
Ultimate: Backup Plan
Once per long rest, you take an extra full turn after any turn in which an attack or action failed.
evolves: If your backup saves you a hundred times, Spare Part recharges on a short rest.
cost: You carry everything twice; your carrying capacity is halved.

unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Vashaix vanished leaving a mirror in the heart of the tree; dance with your reflection until it misses a step and you don't.
secret: You must have turned a spell back on its caster.
notice: [Everything returns. Legendary class: Mirror-Blade Dancer.]
blurb: Follows Vashaix, the Thread-Spinning Keeper who vanished into Reflection, sending force, light and magic back where it came from: a mortal whose blade is a mirror.
features: Skill: Mirror Edge
As a reaction when targeted by a spell, you can reflect it back at its caster on a successful Dexterity save.
Skill: Light Turned
When you reflect, you gain +2 AC until your next turn.
Ultimate: Hall of Mirrors
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every spell and ranged attack that targets you or allies within 30 feet is reflected back.
evolves: If you reflect a god's Law, Mirror Edge works on Laws as well as spells.
cost: Mirrors pull you; you must look into every mirror you pass or take 1d10 psychic damage.

unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Braraas's corpse lies wrapped in a thousand bindings; unbind them one by one, knowing one of them holds something that should stay bound.
secret: You must have freed something dangerous on purpose because keeping it caged was wrong.
notice: [Bindings undone. Legendary class: Unbinder of the Choir.]
blurb: Follows Braraas, killed by Release, the opposite of Bind and the more dangerous when used on the wrong thing: a mortal who lets things go.
features: Skill: Let Go
As an action, end any binding, restraint, grapple, curse or seal within 30 feet.
Skill: Unleashed
When you end a binding, the freed creature or power deals 3d10 force damage to every enemy within 10 feet of it.
Ultimate: The Great Release
Once per long rest, every binding, seal and contract within 120 feet ends, and wild magic surges through enemies for 6d10 damage.
evolves: If you release a god from their own Rune, you gain one of their Laws for a day.
cost: You cannot bind or hold anything; your grapples always fail and locks you close spring open.

unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Zezeyr vanished leaving a single chair; sit in it for a day while the choir sings you to leave, and do not move.
secret: You must have refused to move from a place you were asked to guard, even when relieved.
notice: [Unchanged. Legendary class: Stone-Still Sentinel.]
blurb: Follows Zezeyr, who vanished into Remain, keeping something exactly where and how it is: a mortal who cannot be moved or changed.
features: Skill: Unchanged
You cannot be moved, polymorphed or aged against your will, and you gain +1 AC while you have not moved this turn.
Skill: Hold the Place
Objects and allies within 10 feet cannot be moved or changed by enemy effects.
Ultimate: As It Was
Once per long rest, for 1 minute everything within 60 feet stays exactly as it is: no damage, movement or changes.
evolves: If you hold one doorway for a full year without leaving it, that place becomes a sanctuary no enemy can enter.
cost: You resist all change, even good: spells that raise your stats, speed or size have no effect on you.

unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Orleas vanished leaving a pair of footprints that repeat a dance forever; repeat the dance perfectly a hundred times.
secret: You must have done the same task every day for ten years.
notice: [Action copied. Legendary class: Echo-Step Duellist.]
blurb: Follows Orleas, who vanished into Repeat, a Law that copies an action rather than a shape: a mortal whose every move happens twice.
features: Skill: Echo
Once per turn, after you take an action, you can repeat it as a bonus action at half effect.
Skill: Learned by Repeating
After seeing an enemy use an action twice, you gain advantage against that action.
Ultimate: The Hundredth Time
Once per long rest, you repeat your last action ten times at full effect.
evolves: If you repeat a god's action in front of them, Echo repeats at full effect instead of half.
cost: You fall into habits; your first action in every fight must be the one you opened your last fight with.

unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Ostshaeth vanished leaving a pair of dice; roll them until you get the result you need, but you only win if you stop the moment you get it.
secret: You must have lost everything on a bet and laughed.
notice: [Outcome undone. Probability decides again. Legendary class: Second-Chance Gambler.]
blurb: Follows Ostshaeth, who vanished into Reroll, a Void law that undoes one outcome and lets Probability decide again: a mortal who gets second chances.
features: Skill: Roll Again
Once per short rest, reroll any d20 roll made within 60 feet.
Skill: Lucky Streak
Each reroll you make grants +1 to your next d20 roll (up to +5), resetting on a long rest.
Ultimate: Rewrite the Odds
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you can reroll every die rolled within 60 feet.
evolves: If one of your rerolls ever turns a natural 1 into a natural 20 when a life depends on it, Roll Again can be used twice per short rest.
cost: Your luck is borrowed; every reroll you use gives the DM one reroll against you.

unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Kavan's corpse lies under a hundred different attacks it endured; endure each one, too, without fleeing.
secret: You must have survived a blow that should have killed you.
notice: [Resistance learned. Legendary class: Ward-Skinned Holdout.]
blurb: Follows Kavan, the Pale Keeper killed by Resistance, the defensive answer to nearly anything: a mortal who learns to resist what hurts them.
features: Skill: Learned Ward
After taking damage of a type, you gain resistance to it until your next long rest.
Skill: Hold Out
You add your proficiency bonus to all saving throws.
Ultimate: Unbreakable Ward
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you resist all damage and cannot be moved, knocked prone or stunned.
evolves: If you survive a single hit that deals more than your maximum hit points, Learned Ward resistances last a week.
cost: You can hold only three Learned Ward resistances at once; each new one replaces the oldest.

unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Ultheane's corpse has risen to finish an unpaid vengeance; finish it for them, and take their oath as yours.
secret: You must have sworn vengeance and kept the oath for a year.
notice: [Vengeance owed. Legendary class: Oath-Risen Avenger.]
blurb: Follows Ultheane, killed and risen for a single act of vengeance with a quarter of their power kept for that purpose alone: a mortal who cannot die before the deed is done.
features: Skill: Sworn Target
Choose one creature that wronged you; you always know its location and deal an extra 3d10 damage to it.
Skill: Not Yet
While your target lives, you return to 1 hit point when you die, once per day.
Ultimate: Vengeance Fulfilled
Once per long rest, your next attack against your target is a critical hit dealing maximum damage.
evolves: If your vengeance is fulfilled, you may swear a new oath against a new target, or lay the class down with your honour whole.
cost: Your Skills work only against your sworn target, and while it lives your long rests restore only half your hit points.

unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Time vanished leaving a broken cup; make it unbroken by running its time backward, without touching anything larger.
secret: You must have fixed a mistake before anyone noticed.
notice: [Time reversed. Legendary class: Back-Turner of Small Things.]
blurb: Follows Time's Reverse, running time backward over small things only: a mortal who undoes small mistakes.
features: Skill: Turn Back
As an action, return an object or creature within 30 feet to how it was a round ago.
Skill: Undo
Once per short rest, as a reaction, undo one attack against you.
Ultimate: Reverse the Round
Once per long rest, reverse the last round for everything within 60 feet.
evolves: If you reverse a mortal wound on a dying creature and it lives, Turn Back can reach a minute back instead of a round.
cost: You can never reverse anything larger than yourself, and each reversal turns one of your hairs grey; at a hundred, you age a year.

unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Kakaos vanished leaving four empty saddles on four restless horses; ride each one in turn across the floor without being thrown, then make all four run as one.
secret: You must have led a group of riders who each wanted to go a different way, and brought them home together.
notice: [Four as one. The ride begins. Legendary class: Herald of the Four Saddles.]
blurb: Follows Kakaos, who vanished into Riding, the Law that lets the end-times powers move as one instead of four: a mortal whose mount and allies charge as a single body.
features: Skill: Bonded Mount
You gain a loyal mount with hit points equal to five times your level; while riding, you and it share your AC and act on your turn.
Skill: Ride as One
When you Dash while mounted, up to three mounted allies within 30 feet may move with you, and each of your charges deals an extra 1d10 damage.
Ultimate: The Four Arrive
Once per long rest, you and up to three allies charge as one in a 120 foot line: creatures in the path take 6d10 damage and are knocked prone.
evolves: If your mount carries you through a realm's Tower without stopping, it gains wings or fins as the realm demands.
cost: You must ride everywhere; walking more than a mile on foot gives you a level of exhaustion.

unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Liotheeth's corpse wears a ring on every finger but one; find the ring that fits that last finger among a thousand in the hall, and wear it until Liotheeth's hand opens.
secret: You must have worn the same ring for ten years without ever taking it off.
notice: [A Law kept close. Legendary class: Circle-Keeper of the Close Law.]
blurb: Follows Liotheeth, killed holding Ring, a shape for carrying a Law close to a Person without wielding it: a mortal whose rings hold powers for later.
features: Skill: Kept Close
You can attune to up to ten rings, and each ring can hold one spell you cast into it to release later as a bonus action.
Skill: Circle of Charm
While you wear at least three rings, creatures within 30 feet have disadvantage on saves against your enchantment spells.
Ultimate: Ten Rings Open
Once per long rest, you release every spell stored in your rings at once, all as part of one action.
evolves: If you forge a ring that holds a god's Law, Kept Close can hold Laws as well as spells.
cost: If anyone takes one of your rings, you lose all stored spells and the thief knows your name.

unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Selzeth's corpse is wrapped in roots that grow toward something hidden; follow them down through the mist, losing your way on purpose, until you find the seed at the end.
secret: You must have planted a tree and watched it grow taller than you.
notice: [Roots first. Legendary class: Deep-Tap Rootwalker.]
blurb: Follows Selzeth, killed holding Root, the part of a plant Nature Laws reach first: a mortal who reaches everything below the surface first.
features: Skill: Root Sense
While touching soil, you sense every creature and buried thing within 60 feet.
Skill: Root Bind
As an action, roots grasp a creature within 60 feet: restrained until it escapes (Strength save).
Ultimate: Deep Roots
Once per long rest, roots erupt in a 60 foot radius: enemies are restrained and take 4d10 piercing damage each turn for 1 minute.
evolves: If a tree grown from Selzeth's seed bears fruit, Root Sense covers a mile.
cost: You must touch bare earth daily or lose your powers until you do.

unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Morroar vanished leaving a garden of plants that rot only when watched; watch them all rot and eat what grows from the rot.
secret: You must have eaten mushrooms grown on a corpse and lived.
notice: [Rot accepted. Legendary class: Mould-Crowned Withering.]
blurb: Follows Morroar, who vanished into Rot, the Nature twin of Decay that claims plants: a mortal whose touch spreads rot and fungus.
features: Skill: Creeping Rot
When you hit, the target takes 1d10 necrotic damage at the start of its turns for 1 minute; plants and plant creatures take double.
Skill: Fungal Cloak
Fungi grow on you: +1 AC and resistance to poison.
Ultimate: The Great Mould
Once per long rest, a 60 foot area rots: enemies take 6d10 necrotic damage, plants wither, and fungus rises to fight for you.
evolves: If you rot an entire forest, fungus becomes your mount and army.
cost: Plants wither near you; you cannot heal with herbs and your food spoils by the hour.

unlock: At the top of the Sunken Spire, Ortheis vanished leaving a stone polished smooth by ten thousand hands; rub it while you descend until it glows.
secret: You must have soothed a sick child with nothing but your hands.
notice: [Contact accepted. Legendary class: Palm of the Sunken Stone.]
blurb: Follows Ortheis, who vanished into Rub, a minor contact Law paired with Ointment: a mortal whose touch soothes and strips away harm.
features: Skill: Soothing Rub
As a bonus action, rub a creature to restore 2d10 hit points and end one condition.
Skill: Rub Away
Your touch can remove curses and magical marks.
Ultimate: The Long Touch
Once per long rest, you touch every ally within 30 feet: they regain 6d10 hit points and end all conditions.
evolves: If you work Thaldoth's ointment into a wound with your bare hands, Soothing Rub heals 6d10 instead.
cost: Rub works only on bare skin; armour, scales or cloth in the way halve all your healing.
